outputs.explanation: Panel A shows an H&E histology image and spatial transcriptomics heat maps overlaid on tissue sections; these are not quantitative summary plots requiring individual data points.
Panel B consists of H&E and RNAscope fluorescence micrographs, not a quantitative plot.
Panel C is a dot plot showing each individual tumor sample (LUAD and LUSC) as a separate point, with the median and 95% CI overlaid, so individual data points are visible.
Panel D is a bar chart of mean ± SD with individual replicate data points (dots) overlaid for each of the four groups.
